name: io.github.abuhamza/tideways-mcp-server
title: Tideways
description: Read-only access to Tideways PHP performance monitoring: performance, issues, traces, history.

environmentVariables.name: TIDEWAYS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Tideways API token (Organization settings → API Access; scopes metrics, traces, errors).

environmentVariables.name: TIDEWAYS_ORG
environmentVariables.description: Tideways organization (optional; derived from the token).

environmentVariables.name: TIDEWAYS_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: Default project, "project" or "organization/project" (optional if the token reaches one project).

environmentVariables.name: TIDEWAYS_SERVICE
environmentVariables.description: Default service, e.g. web (optional; API default is the project's default service).
